Passport and ID are not interchangeable alternatives.

citations.evidenceText: Counseling and Wellbeing is free for UAEU students. Appointment channels are the booking system, walk-in office or email. Insurance is required for psychiatry referral. Counseling attendance is not added to the academic record. Separately, disclosure normally requires prior written consent, with stated confidentiality exceptions for danger to self/others and sexual abuse/harassment of children. These exceptions do not mean counseling is added to academic records. The catalog lists 1 hour delivery and no required document.
